name: Witch
ability: Each night, choose a player: if they nominate tomorrow, they die. If just 3 players live, you lose this ability.
designRole: Curses a chosen player's next-day nomination to cause death, unless the live-player threshold removes the ability.
explanation: Curses a chosen player's next-day nomination to cause death, unless the live-player threshold removes the ability.
